label: Post Office
brief: One-storey Classical Revival federal post office on a raised basement: red brick with white limestone base, recessed panels, a wide white entablature and a balustraded parapet. The entrance front has a tetrastyle portico of smooth Ionic-style columns under a pediment with a carved eagle cartouche, reached by a broad flight of steps with iron rails. Tall multi-pane windows, corner flagpole, blue mail drop boxes at the curb.
